records.text: Young American Revival formerly member of Turning Point USA

appearances.snippet: A turning point USA chapter at the University of Arkansas announcing it is rebranding and disaffiliating with the national group. ... The chapter's president said in a statement posted on social media that the executive board had become concerned with the direction of the national group.
